must_have.title: Landing page — full approved section stack
must_have.description: Single-page landing matching the approved design (checkpoint 3.2): sticky nav (logo, 6 section links, EN/ID pill toggle, Join Waitlist CTA) → dark hero → proof bar (4 stats) → The problem (3 pain tiles + Senen market quote) → How it works (3 steps + 'The same search, two outcomes' comparison) → buyer strip → Why Mobeeli blue band → AI catalog showcase card → Early Adaptors (3 benefit cards + waitlist CTA) → Team (3 founders) → Investors → Unify band with Indonesia map → dark footer.
acceptance_criteria: All 13 sections present in the approved order with approved copy (EN and ID)
Brand tokens match the design (Plus Jakarta Sans, #2f7df6 palette, #0d1522 dark surfaces, 18px card radii, pill buttons)
Anchor navigation works from nav links with sticky-header scroll offset
Section reveal animations on scroll (data-rev pattern) with reduced-motion fallback

must_have.title: 3D hero fitment scene
must_have.description: Port fitment-3d.js: <fitment-wheel> three.js scene — blueprint wireframe car, camera on front arch, wheel mounts onto studs, 4 bolts streak in and seat with a flash ring on a ~7s loop; spec labels (PCD, center bore, authenticity) appear after the first loop; floating white cards over the scene (part card 'Front brake pad set / Rp 385.000 / ✓ Verified fit', fit pill '✓ Fits: Toyota Avanza 1.5 G 2019', video card); lang attribute switches label language; 'static' attribute for reduced motion.
acceptance_criteria: Scene renders and loops as in the design on desktop and mobile
Labels + hero cards appear after the first mount (fitment-first-loop event)
reduced-motion renders the static seated state
Language toggle updates the 3D scene labels

must_have.title: Hero headline rotation
must_have.description: H1 rotates four approved phrase pairs per language every ~3.4s with the two-line slide transition: 'Every part, / verified to fit.' → 'One platform, / to unify the auto industry.' → 'Every checkout, / protected on both sides.' → 'Every seller, / keeping more of every sale.' (ID equivalents as written in the design).
acceptance_criteria: Four pairs rotate in both languages
Rotation pauses under reduced motion
No layout shift (min-height reserved)

must_have.title: Full-site EN/ID i18n
must_have.description: Every string on both pages driven by the approved TXT maps (en + id, with 'deck' number variants where defined); pill toggle in nav; choice persisted in localStorage ('mobeeli-lang'); html lang attribute updated; 3D scenes receive the lang.
acceptance_criteria: 100% of approved i18n keys present in both languages, text taken verbatim from the design
Language persists across pages and reloads
Default language configurable (default: en)

must_have.title: AI catalog showcase animation
must_have.description: Dark rounded card: XLS/PDF/JPG file chips + AI status chip ('reading 3 catalogs…' → 'catalog assembled ✓'), six 3D part sprites (pad, filter, plug, disc, shock, air) that pop in one-by-one with name chips, glide onto a circle and orbit with self-spin, bloom out to a grid, then snap-assemble with the centered '✓ One catalog · 120M+ mappings' pill; ~15s loop, IntersectionObserver start/stop, static assembled state under reduced motion.
acceptance_criteria: Phased loop matches the design (pop-in → orbit → bloom → assemble → restart)
AI status chip text flips at the right phase in both languages
Animation only runs while the card is in view
Reduced motion shows the assembled static state

must_have.title: Indonesia flyover map (Unify band)
must_have.description: Port indo-globe.js: <indo-globe> dot-matrix archipelago flyover — tilted land plane, two-tone blue island dots with pseudo-elevation, faint ocean grid, fog horizon, west↔east camera drift, drag to pan (clamped), Jakarta marker with pulse ring + label ('— first market, 2026') and animated arcs to 6 cities.
acceptance_criteria: Map renders at 1.9:1 in the Unify band and matches the design
Drag pans; idle drift resumes after 3s
Jakarta label translates with the language toggle

must_have.title: Join Waitlist page — 4-step wizard
must_have.description: Split-screen page: dark brand panel (0% offer chip, headline, 3 benefits, floating part sprites) + wizard card. Steps: intro → 1/4 business type (Store/Garage/Distributor) → 2/4 business name + contact name (labels/placeholders adapt to type) → 3/4 email/phone/WhatsApp/city (all optional, validated when present) → 4/4 volume, tools (garage only) or brands, Net-30 interest, message → success panel with personalized thank-you, WhatsApp deep link (prefilled message) and back-to-home. Progress bar, slide transitions, honeypot field, EN/ID toggle.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 steps + intro + success behave as in the design, including per-type field switching (tools for garages, brands otherwise)
Validation: business name required; email/phone/WhatsApp format-checked only when filled; inline errors in the active language
WhatsApp CTA builds the prefilled wa.me link with business name and language-appropriate message
Honeypot present; wizard usable entirely on mobile

must_have.title: Waitlist lead capture backend
must_have.description: Real persistence for wizard submissions (the design stops at a client-side success panel). Store every submission (type, businessName, contactName, email, phone, whatsappNumber, city, monthlyOrderVolume, toolsUsed, brandsCarried, net30Interest, message, lang, timestamp) and notify the founding team. Exact mechanism (DB + API route, form service, or email relay) decided at strategy phase.
acceptance_criteria: Submission is persisted before the success panel shows; failure shows a retriable error, not silent loss
Founding team receives/can access every lead
Honeypot-flagged and malformed submissions rejected server-side
No exact-fee copy anywhere in stored/notification templates

must_have.title: Waitlist CTA wiring
must_have.description: Nav 'Join Waitlist' and Early Adaptors CTA route to the Join Waitlist page (same site), replacing the design's waitlistUrl/mailto fallback; buyer strip 'Get notified' and investor 'Request the deck' keep their mailto: actions to info@mobeeli.com with the approved subjects.
acceptance_criteria: Both waitlist CTAs open the wizard page
Buyer and investor mailtos use approved addresses and subject lines
Founder direct emails listed in Investors section

must_have.title: Investor deck request + timed hosted deck viewer
must_have.description: Founder-in-loop deck flow: /investors 'Request the deck' opens a bilingual form (name, firm/fund, work email required; LinkedIn/website + message optional; honeypot) â†’ rate-limited POST /api/deck-request â†’ Resend alert to the team with the requester's details and three mint options (primary 'Generate 1-hour deck link' button; plain text links for a non-expiring link and a custom-hours link) â†’ founder-only /deck-admin page gated by DECK_SECRET mints stateless HMAC-signed tokens â†’ /deck?token= renders the private pitch deck (private/deck/mobeeli-pitchdeck.pdf, never under public/) on pdfjs canvases with no download UI, streaming bytes from token-gated /api/deck-file; expired links show a bilingual re-request page. Email-only â€” no database writes.
acceptance_criteria: Request form validates and alerts the team with the three mint options (1-hour primary button, non-expiring + custom-hours text links)
/deck-admin 404s without the correct DECK_SECRET; presets auto-generate; custom hours input works; links shown with expiry + copy button
Tokens are tamper-proof HMAC with exp|null enforced server-side on /deck and /api/deck-file (403 without valid token)
Viewer renders all deck pages on canvases with no native PDF toolbar or download button; deck routes are noindex and not in the sitemap
Expired links show the bilingual 'link has expired' page pointing to /investors

should_have.title: SEO + social meta
should_have.description: Title/description per language, Open Graph/Twitter cards with a brand image, canonical URL, sitemap, robots; favicon from the Mobeeli mark.
acceptance_criteria: OG preview renders logo + tagline when shared on WhatsApp/LinkedIn
Lighthouse SEO ≥ 90

should_have.title: Analytics for funnel measurement
should_have.description: Privacy-light analytics: page views, language choice, wizard step progression, submission success — enough to measure the Early Adaptor funnel.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard drop-off per step is measurable
No cookie-consent-triggering trackers unless approved

should_have.title: Hero video card (unify-graph.mp4)
should_have.description: The floating hero card plays the unify-graph video ('One platform. Five links.'). Asset supplied by the user on 2026-07-22 (assets/unify-graph.mp4, 1.3 MB) — compress/transcode at build if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Muted, looping, lazy-loaded video in the floating card
Poster/first frame shown until playback starts; no layout shift

should_have.title: Team headshots
should_have.description: Replace image-slot drop targets with real founder headshots when supplied; until then keep the design's gradient placeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Headshot images slot into the 1:1 card area without layout change

could_have.title: Numbers canon switch
could_have.description: Build-time or config flag mirroring the design's 'numbers' prop: brief (120M+, 9 of 14) vs deck (190K+, 38 of 60) variants.
acceptance_criteria: Flag flips all deck-variant strings consistently in both languages

could_have.title: Buyer notify-me form
could_have.description: Upgrade the buyer strip's mailto to a one-field email capture stored alongside waitlist leads.
acceptance_criteria: Email stored and confirmed inline without leaving the page

wont_have.title: Marketplace product features
wont_have.description: No login, search, listings, checkout, or seller dashboard.
wont_have.reason: This project is the pre-launch marketing site + waitlist only; the marketplace itself is a separate product built by the CTO.

wont_have.title: Blog/CMS
wont_have.description: No content management system in this phase.
wont_have.reason: Copy is finalized and reviewed in the design; it ships in code per the approved TXT maps — a CMS adds cost with no pre-launch benefit.
